release_notes: 🔥 Track your daily Qur'an habit with the new Reading Streak icon in the header — iHafidh is now a true Qur'an habit-building app!
👥 Introducing Community Stats! See how the Ummah is using iHafidh — motivation galore 🚀
🌙 Smart Fasting Notifications, plus other stability fixes.
🌍 Tap "Memorized" or "Revised" again on your past verses to count yourself in the Ummah Stats — every tap adds to the collective journey!
✨ Every share is a Sadaqah Jaariyah in the making. Invite your family & friends to iHafidh and earn ongoing rewards as they read, memorize & grow closer to the Qur'an 📖. JazakAllahu Khairan 🤲

announcement.title: Help More Muslims Find iHafidh
announcement.content: Alhamdulillah — if this app has helped you, leaving a quick App Store review is Sadaqah Jariyah. Every Muslim who discovers iHafidh through your review earns you ongoing reward. 🤲
